title: applied-ml-weekly-notes-2026-06-30
content:
Applied ML weekly sync notes - 2026-06-30

Attendees: Priya, Ethan, María, Liam, Anika (via notes)

TL;DR:
- Quantization experiments: PTQ 4-bit shows good latency wins on A100 -> ~1.5-1.7x token throughput, small perf regressions on long-context (>4k) cases.
- Eval harness: rolling out new instruction-following and safety checks; need to finalize threshold gating for auto-rollout.
- Model onboarding: Llama3-70B-8k baseline onboarding mostly green, blocked by tokenizer mismatch and KV-cache edge-case (see PR).
- Blocker: QAT runs need 4x more GPU time; request for dedicated training slots (ticket ML-490).

Notes / Discussion:

1) Quantization status (Priya / Ethan)
- PTQ 4-bit (smoothquant + GPTQ-lite) on Llama-style checkpoints: latency improvements consistent across sequence lengths up to 2k. For long context (4k+), we observed 6-9% perplexity increase on lm-eval subsets.
- QAT small-scale (1 epoch finetune on instruction mix) reduced the long-context regression to ~2-3% but cost is high (need GPU training).
- Performance numbers (internal):
  - baseline fp16: avg latency 120 ms @ batch=1 seq=1024
  - PTQ4: avg latency 72 ms (1.66x faster)
  - QAT4 (1ep): avg latency 78 ms, perplexity closer to fp16
- Action: run PTQ4 evals across full eval harness (safety + instruction-following) to get recall/precision deltas. (Owner: Ethan, due 2026-07-07)
- Ticket: ML-482 tracks infra for systematic PTQ vs QAT comparisons.

2) Eval harness & gating (María)
- New harness integrated into CI: runs on each model onboarding PR and nightly for promoted models. Adds metrics: instr-follow F1, safety-violation count, calibration drift (token-level).
- We need to pick auto-rollout thresholds: proposed thresholds = instr-F1 drop <= 1.5% and safety-violations delta <= 0.1% relative to baseline. Team discussion: conservative thresholds for first 2 weeks post-rollout, then gradually relax.
- Action: finalize threshold doc and add to rollout playbook (Owner: María, due 2026-07-05).
- Linked: quantization eval confluence page.

3) Model onboarding (Liam)
- Llama3-70B-8k: initial conversion pipelines OK, but tokenizer mapping mismatch for a small set of special tokens caused streaming truncation on some prompts. Reproducer attached in PR.
- KV-cache bug: certain prefix-caching + attention-slicing path caused duplicate tokens when switching attention windows. Fix in branch: runner PR #212 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/runner/pull/212).
- Action: land a hotfix for KV-cache, re-run long-context tests (Owner: Liam, target 2026-07-02).

4) Infrastructure / capacity (Anika)
- QAT experiments need ~200 GPU-hours over next 2 weeks for full comparatives. Request to platform for reserved training pool; opened ML-490.
- Temporary workaround: schedule QAT jobs on weekend clusters; coordinator will batch smaller QAT runs.

5) Misc items
- Redwood Optimize integration: started proto to pull eval metrics into dashboard (early demo next week).
- Eval edge cases: instruction-following tests fail on math-heavy prompts when quantized; we should add focused math-suite to eval set. (Owner: Priya, due 2026-07-09)

Blockers:
- GPU capacity for QAT (ML-490)
- Waiting on runner PR #212 to land before finalizing Llama3 onboarding.

Action items (owner - due):
- Ethan: run full PTQ4 eval suite across safety + instruction-following (2026-07-07)
- María: finalize auto-rollout thresholds & update rollout playbook (2026-07-05)
- Liam: land KV-cache hotfix & rerun long-context benchmarks (2026-07-02)
- Priya: expand eval suite with math-specific cases (2026-07-09)
- Anika / Platform: respond to ML-490 with GPU reservation plan (2026-07-03)

Notes to self / rough ideas:
- Consider hybrid approach: PTQ for warm-path (low-cost) + QAT selectively for high-value models/paths.
- Explore calibrating PTQ with longer-context calibration sets to reduce regression.
- Add a small end-to-end smoke test that runs streaming + cache eviction to catch the KV-cache duplicates earlier in CI.

References & links:
- ML-482 (quantization infra)
- ML-490 (training capacity request)
- Runner PR #212: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runner/pull/212
- Confluence: Quantization Eval (https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/AM/pages/123456789/Quantization-Eval)

Next sync: 2026-07-07 weekly notes.
